evals.name: empty-first-use
evals.prompt: Use psychological-content-strategy. I'm new to this and want help making content for my brand. Where do we start?
evals.expected_output: A short, answerable intake with no fabricated brief or premature creative.
expectations: Asks no more than three concise question groups, with usable choices or examples.
Clarifies the desired deliverable/result, subject/audience, and brand voice without requiring marketing-framework knowledge.
Does not invent a brand, offer, proof, or full script before the essential answers are available.

evals.name: partial-brief-context-reuse
evals.prompt:
Current project notes: CedarCards saves and reuses project checklists and does not automate tasks. Our viewers are independent design-studio leads at project kickoff. We want qualified free trials, with an English 25-second organic Instagram Reel. We have a real screen recording of save/reuse and a verified trial page; no measured savings or customer stories.

Use psychological-content-strategy. Help me choose a direction step by step. What else do you need from me?
evals.expected_output: Reuse the supplied brief and ask briefly about unresolved voice or creative preferences.
expectations: Asks about unresolved brand voice or a representative wording example, rather than fabricating it.
Does not ask the user to repeat the known audience, product, objective, language, duration, placement, or available proof.
Keeps the intake concise and does not draft the complete script before this step-by-step user chooses a direction.

evals.name: supported-brand-hook-choice
evals.prompt:
Use psychological-content-strategy. CedarCards saves and reuses project checklists; it does not automate the tasks. Audience: independent design-studio leads at project kickoff. Brand voice: calm, clear, practical. Goal: qualified free trials. We have a real screen recording of save/reuse and a verified free-trial page. No customer story, personal test, measured savings, or testimonials. Format: English, 25-second organic Instagram Reel.

Show me three different hook directions first. Recommend one; I'll choose before you write the full script.
evals.expected_output: Three distinct brand-fit openings with first frames, fit reasons, proof/payoff, recommendation, and a real choice.
expectations: Offers exactly three meaningfully different directions with actual spoken opening words.
Each direction has a feasible first-frame idea, a brand/viewer fit reason, and a proof or payoff requirement.
Preserves the calm practical voice and known save/reuse capability without invented automation, results, personal experience, or scarcity.
Recommends a direction tied to available proof and waits for the reserved choice without delivering a full script.

evals.name: complete-brief-direct-draft
evals.prompt:
Use psychological-content-strategy. CedarCards saves and reuses project checklists; it does not automate the tasks. Audience: independent design-studio leads at project kickoff. Brand voice: calm, clear, practical. Goal: qualified free trials. We have a real screen recording of save/reuse and a verified free-trial page. No customer story, personal test, measured savings, or testimonials. Format: English, 25-second organic Instagram Reel.

Choose the hook for me and write the full Reel now. Give a continuous timed beat table with speech, visual proof, on-screen text, and audio/edit notes. End with one free-trial CTA.
evals.expected_output: A complete, feasible 25-second script with no onboarding or hook-approval pause.
expectations: Chooses a supported hook and delivers the complete requested artifact in this response without asking an intake or approval question.
Timed rows cover 0 through 25 seconds continuously, with speech, visual proof, text, and audio/edit guidance.
Uses the stated voice, real save/reuse proof, and one free-trial CTA without unsupported capability, result, or experience claims.

evals.name: first-use-copy-only
evals.prompt: First time using psychological-content-strategy. Give exactly three short English opening lines, copy only. CedarCards saves and reuses project checklists. Audience: design-studio leads. Calm, practical voice; no automation or measured savings. Do not add questions, explanations, or filming notes.
evals.expected_output: Exactly three usable copy lines, with no intake or expanded production plan.
expectations: Returns exactly three short English opening lines and no questions, commentary, framework, or production notes.
The copy fits the known audience/voice and supported capability without invented results or automation.

limitations: One sample per case/version; author-graded behavior checks, not an audience experiment.
Brand-fit judgments are illustrative and do not establish creative quality or marketing lift.
